scope: Retail full CPU/RAM/FPU/MMIO comparisons for sound status byte read-modify-write via native word getter/setter, G2-to-root/root-to-G2 copy and arm/ready/FIFO/release helpers. Independent selected byte update and other byte preservation across offsets, bounds, values 0/ff, modes and banks. Native command completion performs status byte write then clears each packed work flag and resets pending/busy counters; independent buffer/tail/counter checks for 0/1/32 entries. Synthetic hardware/table/context inputs.
